title: Shameless Man Pees in Grocery Store While Stealing Beer and Chicken
description:
Bodycam footage shows an Arizona cop confronting a suspect in a Sprouts Marketplace in December. Maricopa police were called after Joseph D. Chee allegedly urinated in the grocery store while eating a stolen rotisserie chicken and cramming a beer can in his pants. The responding officer told Chee to “put his ***** away” when he detained him. The 24-year-old has had multiple past indecent exposure charges including three convictions, according to court documents. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
